facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at LA-7202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on LA-7202 and ZV-7211 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. LA-7202 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 9 April 2022 a corrective action on LA-7202 and ZV-7211 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
